title: CogDrift-4D: Hierarchical Multimodal Modeling of Temporal Behavioral Decay for MCI Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.20877v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Early detection of mild cognitive impairment remains a critical bottleneck in dementia care, demanding scalable tools capable of capturing subtle behavioral decay. To capture the subtle temporal changes of cognitive decline, we introduce a behavioral dataset collected across seven unscripted multimodal interactions over an 18-month horizon. This dataset formalizes continuous, multi-session interactions into a dense 4D tensor (Batch * Session * Time * Feature) that explicitly preserves concurrent local dynamics alongside long-term changes. To effectively process these complex behavioral patterns, we propose CogDrift-4D: a novel, hierarchical 4D Transformer framework. To capture the complex trajectory of cognitive decline, CogDrift-4D implements a dual-level behavioral fatigue and drift modeling architecture. At the intra-session level, the model computes localized least-squares regression slopes to quantify the acute ``fading'' of frame

translated_title: CogDrift-4D：用于轻度认知障碍检测的时序行为退化的层次化多模态建模
translated_abstract: 轻度认知障碍（MCI）的早期检测仍然是痴呆症护理中的一个关键瓶颈，亟需能够捕捉细微行为退化的可扩展工具。为了捕捉认知衰退的微妙时序变化，我们引入了一个在18个月的时间跨度内、通过七次非脚本化多模态交互收集的行为数据集。该数据集将连续的、多会话的交互形式化为一个密集的4D张量（批次 * 会话 * 时间 * 特征），显式地同时保留了局部动态与长期变化。为了有效处理这些复杂的行为模式，我们提出了CogDrift-4D：一种新颖的层次化4D Transformer框架。为了捕捉认知衰退的复杂轨迹，CogDrift-4D实现了一种双层次的行为疲劳与漂移建模架构。在会话内层面，该模型计算局部最小二乘回归斜率，以量化帧级特征的急性“消退”……
tldr: 该论文提出了CogDrift-4D框架，将18个月内七次多模态非脚本化交互的行为数据构建为4D张量，并通过层次化Transformer的双层架构（会话内疲劳建模与会话间漂移建模）捕捉认知衰退的时序轨迹，从而实现轻度认知障碍的早期检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CogDrift-4D, a hierarchical 4D Transformer framework that constructs behavioral data from seven unscripted multimodal interactions over 18 months into a dense 4D tensor, and captures the temporal trajectory of cognitive decline through a dual-level architecture modeling intra-session behavioral fatigue and inter-session drift for early MCI detection.
